hits.title: Application Security Engineer
hits.location:
Headquarters: United States, Remote

About Glean:
 
Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles.
 
At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level.
 
Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality.
 
If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more - deeply embedded where people get things done. You’ll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company.

 

About the Role:

Glean is looking for an experienced Application Security Engineer with a primary focus on ensuring that our entire technology stack is free of software vulnerabilities (CVEs). This role is responsible for securing our base OS images, ensuring all open-source software (OSS) dependencies are scanned and patched, and integrating cutting-edge security tools into our CI/CD pipeline. The ideal candidate will drive the adoption of solutions like Google’s Assured Open Source Software (OSS) and explore alternative approaches to enhance software security. This role will lead the vulnerability management charter at Glean, identifying, evaluating, and implementing new security technologies and processes to proactively protect our infrastructure.

You will:

  • Own the vulnerability management lifecycle across Glean’s technology stack, from discovery and prioritization through remediation, reporting, and measurement.
  • Harden base OS images and secure open-source dependencies, package managers, and the broader software supply chain.
  • Integrate SAST, DAST, dependency scanning, and automated security validation into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Evaluate, adopt, and develop security solutions and tooling, including Google’s Assured OSS and comparable approaches.
  • Define secure-coding practices and drive engineering adoption through guidance, training, and mentorship.

About you:

  • BA/BS in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related field (or equivalent industry experience).
  • 8+ years of experience in application security and vulnerability management.
  • Deep understanding of software security vulnerabilities, including CVEs, OWASP Top 10, and supply chain risks.
  • Experience with SAST, DAST, dependency scanning, and vulnerability management tools (e.g., Snyk, GitHub Dependabot, Trivy, Clair, Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP). 
  • Hands-on experience with cloud-native security across AWS, GCP, including containers, Kubernetes, and microservices.
  • Ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and drive security adoption across engineering teams.
  • Proactive, pragmatic, and collaborative, with strong problem-solving skills and the ability to balance security with performance and usability.

Location: 

  • This role is remote

Compensation & Benefits:

The standard base salary range for this position is $185,000 - $260,000 annually. Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package including competitive compensation, Medical, Vision, and Dental coverage, generous time-off policy, and the opportunity to contribute to your 401k plan to support your long-term goals. When you join, you'll receive a home office improvement stipend, as well as an annual education and wellness stipends to support your growth and wellbeing. We foster a vibrant company culture through regular events, and provide healthy lunches daily to keep you fueled and focused.
 
We’re committed to building and sustaining a diverse, inclusive workplace. We strive to attract and retain people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we do not discriminate on the basis of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race. 
 
#LI-REMOTE
 
AI-First Mindset at Glean:
 
At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today — prior Glean experience isn't required.

By clicking “Submit Application,” I confirm that I have read the Global Data Privacy Notice and the Applicant Arbitration Agreement, and I agree to the terms.

hits.title: Senior Full-Stack Developer - Marketplace Web & Mobile Platform
hits.location:
Headquarters: Phoenix, Arizona
URL: https://adventuretravel365.com/

Senior Full-Stack Developer - Marketplace Web & Mobile Platform

We have a big idea, and we’re looking for a top-notch Senior Full-Stack Developer to help us bring it to life.

We’re building a new contractor referral and services marketplace, think Thumbtack or Angi, where clients can easily find and connect with contractors and service providers. The vision includes both an interactive web platform and mobile app, with everything from user accounts and referrals to job tracking, payments, advertising, and more.

This is a fully remote, full-time, ongoing position, and we’re open to applicants worldwide.

There are a lot of moving pieces, which is exactly why we’re looking for someone who has built something like this before and gets excited about taking a platform from an idea to a working product, then continuing to grow it with us.

What You’ll Help Us Build

The platform will have two main sides: clients looking for services and contractors/vendors looking for business.

Some of the functionality we’re planning includes:

  • Client and contractor/vendor accounts and profiles
  • Contractor listings, categories, search, and filtering
  • Service requests, inquiries, referrals, and lead management
  • Job and project tracking
  • Client and vendor dashboards
  • Online payments and transaction tracking
  • Reviews and ratings
  • Notifications and communications
  • Banner advertising and paid promotional opportunities
  • Admin tools for managing the platform
  • Reporting and analytics
  • Secure management of user, job, and transaction data

And probably more! We have a strong vision for where we want this to go, but we also want the right developer to help us determine the smartest way to build it.

This will be an evolving platform, so we’re looking for someone who wants to grow with it, not simply complete a checklist of features.

Who We’re Looking For

We’d love to find someone with strong experience in full-stack web and mobile development, especially someone who has worked on a marketplace, booking platform, service-provider network, or another multi-user platform.

You should be comfortable with:

  • Full-stack web development
  • Mobile or cross-platform app development
  • Strong front-end and back-end development
  • Multi-user marketplace platforms
  • User authentication and account management
  • Payment gateway integrations
  • Databases and APIs
  • Third-party integrations
  • Dashboards and reporting
  • Secure, scalable application architecture
  • Cloud hosting and deployment
  • Testing, maintenance, and optimization
  • Using modern AI-powered development tools and integrating AI capabilities into web and mobile applications

If you’ve worked on something similar to Thumbtack, Angi, TaskRabbit, Upwork, or another two-sided marketplace, we definitely want to hear about it.

More Than Just Coding

We’re not looking for someone who simply waits for a list of instructions and starts coding.

We want someone who can look at the big picture, ask the right questions, recommend the best technical approach, flag potential challenges, and help turn our ideas into a platform that’s intuitive, scalable, and built to grow.

You’ll also be expected to study established platforms like Thumbtack and Angi, understand how their user journeys and marketplace functionality work from both the client and service-provider sides, and use those learnings to help us determine the best approach for our own platform.

You should be able to take the project through planning, architecture, development, testing, launch, and beyond, while communicating clearly with a non-technical team along the way.

Strong spoken and written English communication skills are important. You should be comfortable discussing ideas, explaining technical decisions clearly, and communicating regularly with a non-technical team.

This is not a short-term build-and-leave project. We’re looking for someone who can stay with the platform as it grows, helping us continually improve, expand, and maintain it over time.

Interested? Tell Us About Yourself

Please send us:

  • A quick introduction
  • Your resume or LinkedIn profile
  • Your portfolio and links to websites/apps you’ve built
  • Examples of marketplaces, booking platforms, referral systems, or payment-enabled platforms you’ve worked on
  • What you personally worked on for those projects
  • Your experience using AI in development
  • What technologies/frameworks you’d recommend for a project like this and why
  • Your availability

A short video introduction would be great, too! Nothing overly formal, just a quick introduction so we can get to know you, hear about your experience, and get a feel for how you communicate.

Most importantly, show us what you’ve built. If you’ve helped create a multi-sided marketplace similar to Thumbtack or Angi, tell us about it. We’d love to see it.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/adventure-travel-365-senior-full-stack-developer-marketplace-web-mobile-platform

Are you a driven back-end developer who doesn't wait for instructions, but is already thinking two steps ahead? Who experiments with new technologies and smart solutions alongside the job? Then we want to talk to you.

Straight forward but clear: Twikey isn't looking for someone to just execute. We're looking for someone who thinks, does and keeps going when the going gets tough.

Because fintech is evolving at breakneck speed. That calls for real ownership and for someone who can dive deep on the technical side to keep innovating and improving our platform. You get plenty in return, such as the freedom and responsibility to deliver your own projects. Thanks in part to our organisational structure, you can shape your ideas in the short term and see the results of your hard work quickly.

Driven by your passion for building scalable, performant and secure back-end systems, you continuously raise the bar for your own skills and for our product.

As a member of our development team you work closely with our CTO, 3 fellow developers and 2 testers on the core of our software application. A small, strong team in which you take on a role with real impact on the future of our product.

  • You focus on developing and improving the back-end of our platform, optimising the architecture and data processing while keeping the security and stability of our system in mind. This lets you put your technical skills to full use and come up with innovative solutions.
  • With your expertise you'll make valuable suggestions and streamline processes for all our stakeholders, so we can work more efficiently and achieve better results.
  • You provide technical support on integration projects with software houses, banks and large companies, solving complex technical problems. That gives you the chance to work on challenging projects and to get in touch with a wide range of technologies and industries.

Once you know our product inside out, there are plenty of challenging projects for you to help build.

What are we looking for in you?

  • You are driven, curious and enterprising. Not only in your job, but outside of it too. You have a pro-active attitude and are always a few steps ahead: you spot opportunities, grab them and get to work.
  • Technical challenges? You take them on, not because you have to, but because you want to learn. You're a self-starter and quickly get to grips with new technologies, languages or frameworks.
  • You understand that a good product is never "finished". You draw energy from that mix of creating and fine-tuning. You think along, question things and keep building new solutions.
  • You have experience using AI tools to build integrations. You're actively exploring how AI can contribute to smarter user experiences and more efficient software development. Experience with data analytics is an asset.
  • You therefore attach a lot of importance to the security, stability and reliability of a system and know what it takes to get there. You work in a structured, meticulous way and write code that is clean, reusable and easy to test.
  • You have demonstrable experience with Java, Go and the Spring framework. Experience with API integrations, web services, Linux or other relevant areas is a plus.
  • You have a deep understanding of databases. You don't just know how to use them, you know how they work. You have an opinion on structured, high-quality code, architecture and back-end technologies.
  • You have a very good command of English, for smooth collaboration with all colleagues and stakeholders. Dutch is an asset.
  • You are based in a time zone within one hour of CET, so your working day overlaps with the team's for the daily stand-ups and close day-to-day collaboration.
  • You can work independently and enjoy a small team where switching gears quickly, collaboration and knowledge sharing are central.

Twikey offers you:

  • An environment where challenge, innovation and autonomy come first.
  • The room to experiment, to challenge and to improve. And we expect you to really take that room.
  • An ideal setting if you want to grow fast and healthily, both technically and personally. Training, ownership, taking on new or additional roles based on your talents and interests, ... a lot is possible here, and you're at the wheel!
  • A complementary team of more than 35 colleagues who move forward together in a respectful and open atmosphere.
  • A motivating workplace with plenty of knowledge and expertise, shared both formally during the daily stand-ups and the weekly Friday call, and informally at the coffee machine.
  • Appreciation, openness and critical dialogue. Our Friction Hunter Trophy is an example: every month we celebrate the colleague who made the biggest difference for customers, teammates or internally. Your impact gets noticed!
  • A modern workplace with different zones (conference, connect, co-work, concentrate) in a recently built, industrial-style office building. Easy to reach by car, by bike and by public transport on the edge of Ghent, right next to the KBC tower.
  • A salary package tailored to your experience and skills, with plenty of extra-legal benefits, a collective bonus system and a cafeteria plan to convert your 13th month as you choose.
  • The chance to work in an innovative Belgian fintech scale-up that is active in several countries, in a sector that is growing fast!

A job ad doesn't tell you everything. Our colleagues tell you here what it's really like to work at Twikey.

Senior Software Engineer

AccuLynx is a fast-growing SaaS provider of business management software for roofing contractors. With more than 10 years in the business and impressive year-over-year revenue growth, we have quickly established ourselves as the leading software product in this multi-billion dollar industry.

AccuLynx is actively looking for smart and passionate Senior Software Engineers to join our growing Engineering team! We are headquartered out of Beloit, WI and would love to have you join us for major planning sessions and meetings, but this role has the option to be remote. We do not hire based on buzzwords or popular acronyms. We expect you to have mastered at least one language and be eager to master any technology or language in the future. If you want to be part of a collaborative team committed to providing a best-in-class software user experience, please read on!

What You Will Do:

  • Support Engineering team in delivering well-written, well-tested code to complete new features or address issues in the product
  • Collaborate on the design, implementation, testing and review of new features and fixes
  • Review code and contribute feedback to improve the quality, readability, and testability of the code base across Engineering
  • Architect, design, develop, deploy and operate services that serve AccuLynx’s thousands of users
  • Use Agile process to experiment and improve on software development practices at AccuLynx

What might you work on?

  • Implement real time communication tools to connect our customers.
  • Create a fast and responsive work-scheduling application for use in the field.
  • Build an automation platform so our customers can customize their workflow to reduce wasted movement.
  • Solve advanced mapping and geolocation problems.
  • Build out our public RESTful API.
  • Review junior Engineering team members’ work for accuracy and provide coaching and feedback
  • Perform other related duties as assigned

Your Qualifications:

  • Top notch coding skills
  • 7-10 years of software development experience
  • 7+ years of full-stack web development: frontend, backend and database
  • Smart and gets things done
  • Excellent written, verbal and interpersonal communication skills
  • Belief that performance is a feature
  • Experience with our stack: Vue.js, C#, Sql Server, Redis, ElasticSearch, Git
  • Confidence you will make a difference in our product
  • Leverages AI-powered development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) to accelerate coding, testing, and debugging workflows while maintaining high code quality standards
  • Actively evaluates and integrates emerging AI coding assistants into the team's development process, sharing best practices to improve overall engineering velocity

Bonus Points If You Have:

  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies.
  • Understanding of HTML5 and mobile responsive development.
  • Contributions to OSS projects or Stackoverflow.
  • Availability for after hours support. We work at a sustainable 40h/week pace but sometimes things go bump in the night.

Why We Love AccuLynx:

AccuLynx’s success as the #1 business management software for roofing contractors over the past 11 years is thanks to us investing in our employees, maintaining company values and focusing on a strong company culture. Our positive work environment has allowed us to retain employees that have been with us since our company’s inception and has provided the solid groundwork for us to develop an industry-leading product while exceeding our customer’s expectations. Because of our commitment to our company values and culture, we were recently officially recognized as a Great Place to Work Certified™ organization, with 90% of our employees naming AccuLynx as a great place to work.

We’re proud to regularly be recognized for software, product and company culture achievements. Our team’s shared belief in AccuLynx's mission promotes a culture of collaboration, innovation and fun. We have built a benefits program to match the strength of our team. This program includes:

  • Attractive compensation packages

  • 401K matching and safe harbor contributions

Our Interview Process:

We do not hire based on buzzwords or popular acronyms. We expect you to be a master of your domain and be eager to learn any technology or language in the future. We aim to reply to your application within a week of receiving it. Our interview process consists of several stages, each one allowing us get to know you better, professionally and technically. It is also an opportunity for you to gain a better understanding of our culture and the work we do at AccuLynx. The stages include:

  • CV, open source code, or public portfolio review

  • Face to Face conversation with a few members of your team.

Applicants must be able to work legally within the United States. Please, no 3rd party inquiries.

AccuLynx is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to inclusion and employing a diverse workforce. All applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, disability, or other legally protected characteristics.

hits.title: Senior Integration Engineer for Enterprise API & Integration Products
hits.location:
Headquarters:

Summary

We are looking for a Senior Integration Engineer to build and operate integration products connecting Salesforce, SAP, and a carrier data lake. This role combines hands-on integration development with end-to-end production ownership, including API design, data mapping, testing, monitoring, troubleshooting, and recovery.

General information

This role focuses on building reliable, maintainable integrations rather than creating new point-to-point integration debt. You will work across Salesforce, SAP, and carrier data lake environments, taking ownership of integrations throughout their lifecycle—from implementation and testing through production support and continuous improvement.

Strong experience with MuleSoft or a comparable enterprise integration/API platform is expected, along with practical experience integrating with SAP and working with data lake ingestion patterns.

AI-assisted engineering is an explicit expectation for this engagement. You will use AI copilots and agents as part of your daily workflow to accelerate discovery, development, testing, documentation, and operational troubleshooting. You will remain responsible for validating and hardening AI-generated output and for all production decisions.

Tasks and Deliverables

  • Design and implement MuleSoft/API integrations across Salesforce, SAP, and the carrier data lake.
  • Define and maintain API contracts, field mappings, transformations, and automated tests.
  • Use Data Modeler to develop and maintain accurate data mappings between systems.
  • Debug and resolve production integration failures independently, including root-cause analysis and preventative improvements.
  • Instrument integration pipelines with appropriate monitoring, logging, and alerting.
  • Support Marketing Portfolio transition integrations while avoiding unnecessary point-to-point dependencies and new integration debt.
  • Use AI tools to accelerate mapping drafts, API stubs, test generation, documentation, and error-handling boilerplate.
  • Review and harden AI-generated output to ensure it meets production standards for reliability, maintainability, and quality.
  • Automate replay, retry, alerting, and recovery runbooks to reduce mean time to recovery (MTTR).
  • Continuously improve the reliability, observability, and operational efficiency of the integrations you own.

Required experience

  • 5+ years of integration engineering experience.
  • Hands-on experience with MuleSoft or an equivalent enterprise ESB/API integration platform.
  • Experience integrating with SAP, including IDoc, API, and/or BAPI patterns.
  • Experience with Salesforce integrations and enterprise API patterns.
  • Experience with data lake ingestion and integration patterns.
  • Strong understanding of API contracts, data mapping, transformations, testing, and integration architecture.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting integrations in production, including monitoring, troubleshooting, alerting, retry/replay, and incident resolution.
  • Ability to take ownership of production issues and drive them through diagnosis, recovery, and prevention, rather than simply handing them off to another team.
  • Experience using AI copilots or agents to accelerate software engineering workflows.
  • Strong engineering judgment and the ability to validate, test, and improve AI-generated code and artifacts before they reach production.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/toptal-senior-integration-engineer-for-enterprise-api-integration-products
